g.text: ALU CampusCare - UI/UX Design Specification & Prototype Flow
Stage 1: Low-Fidelity Wireframes → Stage 2: Pixel-Sampled ALU Design System (#002E6D / #D00D2D) → Stage 3: High-Fidelity Mobile Screens (393×852)
00. ALU Brand Identity & Design System Tokens
920 × 852 px · Pixel-Sampled from Official ALU Wordmark
Tokens · Typography · Reusable Flutter Widget Specs
Body Copy · 14px w500 (WCAG AA 4.5:1 Contrast Verified)
Mirrors the horizontal red-over-white cut of the ALU
letterforms across section headers and hero cards.
1120 × 620 px · Early Information Architecture & Thumb-Zone Mapping Before Visual Styling
Single login + auto role detection by domain
Primary Report CTA placed in thumb zone + FAB
6 visual category tiles replace free-text typing
1. Brand Fidelity: Primary Navy (#002E6D), Action Red (#D00D2D), and Neutral Grey (#77818D) were sampled directly from the official ALU wordmark.
2. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Domain auto-detection (@alustudent.com vs @alueducation.com) eliminates user error during sign-up.
3. Visibility of System Status: The 3-node StatusTimeline stepper keeps students informed in real time from Submitted → In Progress → Resolved.
4. Accessibility: Light (#F4F6FA) and Dark (#00132F) themes exceed WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast across all status badges and typography.
